app.name: Scene buttons
app.summary: A row of up to three keys on one tile, each turning on a scene of your choice.
app.tile_example: Three keys: A, F and N
app.scene_hint: A scene entity such as scene.living_room_normal. Left empty, the key is not shown.
app.text_size_hint: Auto takes the largest that fits the key. A size too large for the key or the tile is made smaller.
